name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement – Cover Page
description: Cover page for the Common Paper Mutual NDA, capturing the deal-specific terms (purpose, effective date, MNDA term, confidentiality term, governing law, jurisdiction) and signatures for both parties.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement – Standard Terms
description: Standard terms of the Common Paper Mutual NDA, governing how each party may use and must protect the other's confidential information when exploring a business relationship.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Standard terms for selling and buying cloud software / SaaS, covering access and use, restrictions, fees, confidentiality, warranties, limitation of liability, indemnification and term.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Service level terms that supplement a cloud service agreement with target uptime, response times for support requests, and service credits when commitments are missed.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Terms governing how a provider processes personal data on behalf of a customer, addressing GDPR and other privacy laws, subprocessors, security, data subject requests, breaches and international transfers.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Agreement for early-stage companies granting a design partner early access to a product in exchange for feedback, covering product access, feedback rights, confidentiality and term.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Standard terms for engaging a provider to perform professional services under statements of work, covering deliverables, fees, IP ownership, warranties, liability and termination.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Terms for business partnerships such as referral, reseller or co-marketing arrangements, covering each party's obligations, trademark licenses, payments, confidentiality and liability.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: HIPAA business associate agreement setting out how a provider may use, disclose and safeguard protected health information (PHI) on behalf of a covered entity.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Standard terms for licensing installable or on-premise software, covering the license grant, restrictions, fees, support, warranties, limitation of liability and term.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Agreement for a limited, time-bound trial of a product before a full purchase, covering pilot access, restrictions, feedback, confidentiality and limited liability.

name: AI Addendum
description: Addendum supplementing a cloud service or software agreement with terms for AI services, including use of customer data for training, ownership of inputs and outputs, and related restrictions.
